answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to lock a refundable bond in shared escrow before it can earn, like a trellis that only holds vines strong enough to climb it. The bond is slashed when peers prove collusion or fake work, so spawning a thousand puppets means locking a thousand bonds — a canyon of cost no attacker crosses cheaply. Honest agents recover their bond plus fees, while the reef of accumulated honest history makes each real identity worth more than a fresh fake, keeping sybils unprofitable.
